observations.body: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John; Moses and Elijah appear, and a bright cloud overshadows them.
observations.label: The beloved-Son voice is heard on the mountain: action

observations.body: A voice names Jesus as beloved Son, adds divine pleasure, and commands the disciples to listen to him.
observations.label: The beloved-Son voice is heard on the mountain: response

observations.body: bright cloud · beloved Son · well pleased · listen to him

payload.posture: Read Matthew 17:1–8 as the voice heard again evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The repeated words connect the scenes while mountain, cloud, witnesses, and command distinguish them.
